sentences.text:
2024
 The Honourable Sri Justice K.Sarath
 Writ Petition No.13097 of 2024
Order:

This Petition is filed under Section 226 of Constitution of India for following relief:
"to issue any Writ order or direction more particularly one in the nature of WRIT OF MANDAMUS declaring the action of the Respondents in not disposing of the petitioners representation dated 08.12.2023 made requesting to expedite the process of acquisition and pass award under Act 2013 in respect of land admeasuring to an extent of Ac.109.12 gts in Sy.No.166, 167, 169, 170, 172, 173, 174, 175, 211 and 215 of Gazinagar Village, Konda Mallepally Mandal, Nalgonda District as illegal unlawful,
contrary to law and consequently direct the respondents to expedite the land acquisition proceedings by passing award and pay compensation to the petitioner without entertaining any objections made by third parties in respect of the above land and pass..."

2. Heard learned counsel appearing for the petitioner and learned Government Pleader for Land Acquisition appearing for the respondent Nos. 1 to 4 and perused the material on record.
SK,J W.P.No.13097_2024 3.

Learned Government pleader for the respondents submits that on an earlier occasion, the petitioner had filed W.P.No.5154 of 2024 and this Hon'ble Court had passed Orders dated 27.02.2024 by directing the respondents to dispose the petition dated 08.12.2023 in eight (08)
weeks.

4. Learned Government pleader for the respondents, basing on instructions, further submits that after filing of this writ petition, in compliance of the Orders passed by this Court in W.P.No.5154 of 2024 dated 27.02.2024, the respondents conducted Grama Sabha on 25.04.2024 under Section 11(2) of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement (RFCTLARR) Act, 2013 (for brevity, 'the Act, 2013') and they intended to take further steps for next course of action for the declaration of publication under the Act, 2013.

entities.text: Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement (RFCTLARR) Act, 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: 5. In view of the same, the Writ Petition is disposed of directing the respondents to take further steps in SK,J W.P.No.13097_2024 accordance with law within reasonable time.
There shall be no order as to costs.
6. Miscellaneous petitions pending, if any, shall also stand closed.
